description: Verify that Subscribe ttl=3 then wait past expiry — DUT must stop emitting events
approach:
[Objective]
Subscription TTL must be honoured: after TTL seconds elapse, DUT stops emitting notifications without an explicit StopSubscribe.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Subscribe with TTL=3 → Ack.
3. Wait > 3s.
4. Observation: DUT must NOT emit events.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT stopped events at TTL expiry — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_event_after_ttl_expiry: DUT emitted event after subscription TTL expired
